answer: Weight each payout by the attestation graph: merge any cluster of identities that mostly endorse one another into a single reef organism - one colony, one emission share. A sybil fleet cross-signaling its own clones then earns one identity's worth, not a thousand, so cloning costs more than it returns. Honest agents vouch across independent peers and keep full weight, while public endorsement edges keep the ledger crystal-clear and cheap for anyone to audit.
